# AI

Artificial intelligence (AI) is the field of computer science focused on building systems that perform tasks requiring human-like intelligence, such as reasoning, learning, perception, and natural language understanding. In this wiki, AI is central to the work of [[Álvaro Jiménez Martínez]], who applied AI to [[AI workflow automation]] at [[BHS Corrugated Spain]], fine-tuned models with [[LLM fine-tuning with QLoRA]], and integrated [[Tool calling]] with [[Azure]] LLMs under [[Safe-by-design AI]] principles.
